questions.subject: Bahasa Inggris
questions.text:
There is ___ water left in the bottle, so we should refill it soon.

Choose the best option.
questions.pembahasan: 'Water' tak terhitung dan maknanya negatif (hampir habis), sehingga dipakai 'little'. Jawaban: A.

questions.subject: Bahasa Inggris
questions.text:
The results were not ___ with our hypothesis, so we revised the model.

questions.pembahasan: 'be consistent with' membutuhkan adjektiva 'consistent'. Jawaban: B.
